hardening_findings.finding: A18D could read a different A0 candidate universe between precheck and bootstrap persistence when concurrent Evidence ingress occurs.
hardening_findings.required_fix: A0 candidate rows MUST have role_time.ingested_at <= A0 and the first qualified candidate snapshot MUST be cached and replayed unchanged for all A18D bootstrap reads.

hardening_findings.finding: The two-record GFS or delayed exact pair could be committed one fact at a time and leave an unrecoverable 1-of-2 partial dataset after a transient second write failure.
hardening_findings.required_fix: Each exact multi-record dataset MUST commit atomically in one outer transaction while preserving raw-retention verification before canonical ingress.

hardening_findings.finding: A preboundary GFS transient provider/decode failure could terminate the only collector process before the existing soil polling phase.
hardening_findings.required_fix: Permit bounded operational GFS retries only while the actual request start remains earlier than T-30m. Retry cadence is not temporal authority.

hardening_findings.finding: A18D could begin too near O00, write bootstrap state, cross O00, then fail its post-write wall-clock proof.
hardening_findings.required_fix: A18D execute mode MUST reject starts at or after 19:45Z and still require completion before 20:00Z. The 15-minute reserve is operational safety only.

hardening_findings.finding: A18C qualified the Amendment-11 runner but no production O00-O23 workflow invoked it.
hardening_findings.required_fix: Install a DB-only production runner using the exact A18C manifest/config/context pins, actual Evidence snapshot time, persistent sequential scheduler, and the same claimed fence for canonical Runtime persistence.
